"}};
window.ShoppingAudio=class {
  constructor({onSpeaking=()=>{},onAvailability=()=>{}}={}){
    this.onSpeaking=onSpeaking;this.onAvailability=onAvailability;
    this.muted=false;this.paused=false;this.seq=0;this.active=false;
    this.player=document.getElementById('voice-player');this.failure=null;
    this.player.addEventListener('error',()=>{this.failure=new Error('음성 파일을 재생하지 못했습니다. 다시 재생해 주세요.');});
    this.report();
  }
  report(){this.onAvailability({mode:'recorded',label:'Cartesia 음성 · 한국어 / 일본어',detail:'AI: 소연 · 서연: 민지 · 나레이션: 민호 · 일본인 도슨트: 사쿠라'});}
  unlock(){try{this.ac||=new (window.AudioContext||window.webkitAudioContext)();this.ac.resume();}catch{}}
  stop(){this.seq++;this.active=false;this.player.pause();this.player.removeAttribute('src');this.player.load();this.onSpeaking('');}
  pause(){this.paused=true;this.player.pause();}
  resume(){this.paused=false;if(this.active&&!this.player.ended)this.player.play().catch(()=>{this.failure=new Error('음성 재개에 실패했습니다. 다시 재생해 주세요.');});}
  setMuted(value){this.muted=value;this.player.muted=value;}
  async speak(text,role,key,ctx,onProgress=()=>{}){
    ctx.check();const clip=window.RECORDED_AUDIO[key];
    if(!clip)throw new Error('음성 파일이 없습니다: '+key);
    const seq=++this.seq;this.failure=null;this.active=true;
    this.player.src=clip.src;this.player.muted=this.muted;this.player.load();
    this.onSpeaking(role);onProgress(0);

      if(!this.paused)await this.player.play();

    }finally{
      if(seq===this.seq){this.active=false;this.player.pause();this.onSpeaking('');}
    }
  }
  playEffect(kind){
    if(this.muted||this.paused||!this.ac||this.ac.state!=='running')return;
    const c=this.ac,t=c.currentTime;
    if(kind==='shutter'){
      const buffer=c.createBuffer(1,c.sampleRate*.16,c.sampleRate),data=buffer.getChannelData(0);
      for(let i=0;i<data.length;i++)data[i]=(Math.random()*2-1)*Math.exp(-i/(c.sampleRate*.035));
      const s=c.createBufferSource(),g=c.createGain();s.buffer=buffer;g.gain.value=.22;s.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);s.start(t);s.onended=()=>{s.disconnect();g.disconnect();};
    }else{
      const o=c.createOscillator(),g=c.createGain();o.frequency.value=kind==='ready'?880:660;g.gain.setValueAtTime(.035,t);g.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(.001,t+.18);o.connect(g);g.connect(c.destination);o.start(t);o.stop(t+.19);o.onended=()=>{o.disconnect();g.disconnect();};
    }

};

  function showQuestion(text){

  }

    return add(`<div class="scan-box" style="left:${x}px;top:${y}px;width:${w}px;height:${h}px" aria-hidden="true"><i></i><i></i><i></i><i></i><span class="scan-sweep"></span></div>`);
  }
  function showScans(kind){
    if(kind==='request')return [scan(548,250,211,361),scan(805,302,184,319)];
    if(kind==='price')return [scan(698,590,252,163)];

  const wave='<span class="voice-wave"><span></span><span></span><span></span><span></span></span>';

  async function line(key,ctx,{hud=true,persist=false}={}){
    const v=window.SHOPPING_AUDIO[key];ctx.check();
    stage.dataset.line=key;setPhase(v.role==='user'?'question':'answer',v.role==='narrator'?'나레이션':v.role==='user'?'서연의 요청':'AI 음성 해설',65);
    const chunks=(v.text.match(/[^.!?。！？\n]+[.!?。！？]?/g)||[v.text]).map(t=>t.trim()).filter(Boolean);
    const total=chunks.reduce((n,t)=>n+Array.from(t).length,0);
    let el,current=-1;

    function display(progress){
      let sum=0,index=chunks.length-1;
      for(let i=0;i<chunks.length;i++){sum+=Array.from(chunks[i]).length;if(progress<sum/total){index=i;break;}}
      if(index===current)return;current=index;
      const text=chunks[index];subtitle(v.role,text);
      if(hud&&v.role!=='narrator'){
        if(el)el.remove();
        el=add(`<div class="${v.role==='user'?'speech-balloon user-spoken':'glass-card museum-caption'}" data-role="${v.role}"><div class="speaker-label">${v.role==='user'?'서연':'AI 도슨트'}</div><div class="speech-content">${wave}<p>${escape(text)}</p></div></div>`);
      }
    }

    if(el&&!persist)el.remove();await ctx.wait(180);return el;
  }
  async function capture(ctx){
    const el=add('<div class="capture-flash"></div>');sound.playEffect('shutter');
    await ctx.wait(110);el.remove();
  }
  async function playScene(scene,ctx){
    stage.dataset.view=scene.view;stage.dataset.asset=scene.image;
    setPhase('scene-only','장면 시작',5);ctx.check();
    if(scene.kind==='title'){
      subtitle('','일본 여행 중, AI 글래스와 함께하는 미술관 관람');
      await ctx.wait(300);
      await line('narration-start',ctx,{hud:false});

    }
    await ctx.wait(300);

      await line('mode-user',ctx);
      const on=status('도슨트 모드 ON',{toast:true});sound.playEffect('ready');
      await line('mode-ai',ctx);await ctx.wait(650);

      const point=add('<div class="gaze-point" style="left:308px;top:350px"></div>');
      setPhase('recognition','왼쪽 작품 감지 · 촬영',40);await ctx.wait(450);

      setPhase('recognition','설명문 감지 · 촬영',40);await ctx.wait(750);await capture(ctx);mark.remove();
      await line('translate-intro',ctx);
      const translated=window.SHOPPING_AUDIO['translate-ai'].text.split('\n');
      const sentences=translated.slice(3).join(' ').match(/[^.!?]+[.!?]?/g)||[];
      const panel=add(`<section class="translation-full" aria-label="설명문 한국어 번역"><header><span class="translation-eyebrow">한국어 번역</span><h2>${escape(translated[0].replace('제목: ',''))}</h2><dl><div><dt>작가</dt><dd>${escape(translated[1].replace('작가: ',''))}</dd></div><div><dt>재료</dt><dd>${escape(translated[2].replace('재료: ',''))}</dd></div></dl></header><div class="translation-body"><p>${escape(sentences.slice(0,2).join('').trim())}</p><p>${escape(sentences.slice(2).join('').trim())}</p></div></section>`);
      await line('translate-ai',ctx,{hud:false});await ctx.wait(900);
    }else if(scene.kind==='gaze-offer'){

      setPhase('recognition','시선 유지 감지 · 2.3초',35);
      const gaze=add('<div class="gaze-timer" style="left:715px;top:380px"><svg viewBox="0 0 120 120"><circle cx="60" cy="60" r="50" class="track"/><circle cx="60" cy="60" r="50" class="fill"/></svg><b>0.0초</b></div>');
      for(let n=0;n<=46;n++){ctx.check();gaze.querySelector('b').textContent=(n/20).toFixed(1)+'초';gaze.querySelector('.fill').style.strokeDashoffset=314*(1-n/46);if(n<46)await ctx.wait(50);}
      gaze.remove();
      await line('offer-ai',ctx);await line('accept-user',ctx);
      await line('bridge-ai',ctx);
      await line('bridge-user',ctx);
    }else if(scene.kind==='live'){
      await line('live-user',ctx);
      badge('번역 모드 ON','일본어 → 한국어');sound.playEffect('ready');
      const panel=add(`<div class="glass-card live-panel"><div class="speaker-label"><span class="live-dot"></span>일본인 도슨트 · 실시간 번역</div><p class="jp" lang="ja"></p><p class="ko" aria-live="off"></p></div>`);
      let translated='';
      for(const part of ['one','two','three']){
        const jp=window.SHOPPING_AUDIO['jp-'+part],ko=window.SHOPPING_AUDIO['ko-'+part];
        ctx.check();stage.dataset.line='jp-'+part;panel.querySelector('.jp').textContent=jp.text;subtitle('docent',jp.text);
        let done=false;
        const speaking=sound.speak(jp.text,'docent','jp-'+part,ctx).then(()=>{done=true;});
        const typing=(async()=>{

  }

  async function start(index=sceneIndex){
    stop();finishedAll=false;
    const version=runVersion;
    const ctx=new RunContext(version);currentRun=ctx;running=true;paused=false;syncButtons();
    try{
      for(let i=index;i<scenes.length;i++){
        ctx.check();
        if(!await loadScene(i))return;
        ctx.check();
        await playScene(scenes[i],ctx);
        ctx.check();
        completed.add(i);syncNavigation();setPhase('complete','확인 완료',100);
        if(!$('auto-next').checked || i===scenes.length-1){
          running=false;paused=false;finishedAll=i===scenes.length-1;
          $('playback-status').textContent=finishedAll?'전체 시나리오를 확인했어요':'다음 씬을 선택하거나 다시 재생해요';
          syncButtons();return;
        }
        await ctx.wait(150);
      }
    }catch(error){
      if(error.name!=='AbortError' && currentRun===ctx){
        stop();$('playback-status').textContent=error.message;syncButtons();
      }
    }
  }
  function pause(){
    if(!running||paused)return;
    paused=true;sound.pause();for(const a of activeAnimations)a.pause();
    $('playback-status').textContent='잠시 멈춤';syncButtons();
  }
  function resume(){
    if(!running||!paused)return;
    paused=false;sound.resume();for(const a of activeAnimations)a.play();
    $('playback-status').textContent=$('phase-label').textContent;syncButtons();
  }
  $('scene-navigation').innerHTML=scenes.map(s=>`<button class="scene-nav-button" data-scene="${s.id}" aria-label="씬 ${s.id+1}: ${s.title}"><span class="nav-number">${String(s.id+1).padStart(2,'0')}</span><span>${s.short}</span></button>`).join('');
  $('scene-navigation').addEventListener('click',event=>{const button=event.target.closest('button');if(button)selectScene(Number(button.dataset.scene));});
  $('play-button').addEventListener('click',()=>{sound.unlock();if(running){paused?resume():pause();}else start(finishedAll?0:sceneIndex);});
  $('replay-button').addEventListener('click',()=>{sound.unlock();start(sceneIndex);});
  $('previous-button').addEventListener('click',()=>selectScene(sceneIndex-1));
  $('next-button').addEventListener('click',()=>selectScene(sceneIndex+1));
  $('home-button').addEventListener('click',event=>{event.preventDefault();selectScene(0);});
  $('sound-button').addEventListener('click',()=>{muted=!muted;sound.setMuted(muted);if(!muted)sound.unlock();syncButtons();});
  $('fullscreen-button').addEventListener('click',async()=>{
    try{if(document.fullscreenElement)await document.exitFullscreen();else await document.body.requestFullscreen();}
    catch{$('playback-status').textContent='이 브라우저에서는 창을 크게 해서 감상해 주세요';}
  });
  document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden)pause();});
  document.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
    if(event.target.matches('button,input,a'))return;
    if(event.code==='Space'){event.preventDefault();$('play-button').click();}
    if(event.code==='ArrowRight')$('next-button').click();
    if(event.code==='ArrowLeft')$('previous-button').click();
  });
  window.museumPlayer={selectScene,start,pause,resume,getState:()=>({sceneIndex,running,paused,finishedAll}),scenes};
  function resize(){canvas.style.transform=`scale(${stage.clientWidth/1600})`;}
  new ResizeObserver(resize).observe(stage);resize();
  for(const [id,name] of [['fullscreen-button','fullscreen'],['replay-button','replay'],['previous-button','prev'],['next-button','next']])$(id).innerHTML=icon(name);
  stage.classList.add('scene-0');stage.dataset.scene='0';stage.dataset.phase='scene-only';background.src=imageSource(0);background.alt=scenes[0].alt;stage.dataset.view=scenes[0].view;stage.dataset.asset=scenes[0].image;
  showTitle();$('scene-title').textContent=scenes[0].title;$('scene-subtitle').textContent=scenes[0].subtitle;$('scene-counter').textContent='SCENE 01 / 06';
  syncButtons();syncNavigation();
  // Readiness and preloading never insert an overlay or start playback.
  background.addEventListener('load',()=>{if(!running)$('playback-status').textContent='장면부터 천천히 시작해요';},{once:true});
  for(const source of Object.values(window.MUSEUM_IMAGES)){const preloaded=new Image();preloaded.src=source;}
})();


</script></body></html>
